title: Norwegian Warm Omelette
description: A simple and hearty omelette filled with wholesome ingredients, inspired by Norwegian cuisine.
instructions: 1. Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add the butter.
3. Once the butter has melted, add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they're softened.
4. Add the chopped onions and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
5. Pour the whisked eggs over the mushrooms and onions.
6. Add the mashed banana on top of the eggs.
7. Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the banana.
8. Use a spatula to gently fold the omelette in half.
9. Cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the eggs are cooked through.
10. Sprinkle the chopped chives on top and serve hot.
